bio:
Metal Sonic (nicknamed "Normal! Metal Sonic") plays a drastically different role compared to his mainline Sega counterpart. Instead of acting as a cold, loyal weapon for Dr. Eggman, he is forced to become a survivor and a protector.

In this dark timeline, NormalCD breaches the boundaries of Sonic CD and severely injures Sonic the Hedgehog. With the blue blur incapacitated, NormalCD takes absolute control over the domain and begins systematically hunting down the game's remaining residents. To survive the absolute chaos brought by the entity, Amy Rose turns into a tech-savvy mechanic. She discovers a deactivated Metal Sonic and performs a series of drastic, heavy upgrades on him. No longer bound by Eggman's commands, this version of Metal Sonic forms a desperate, close alliance with Amy Rose. Together, they must hide in the shadows of the broken Sonic CD timeline, locked in a near-endless battle of survival to defeat NormalCD and prevent the entity from completely erasing them.
